No domain-specific molecular mechanism or complete family review is claimed; status remains IN_PROGRESS.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure2A and flow Methods distinguish DiOC6 loss from a measured molecular death mechanism; substantial loss remains.
evidence.snippet: Data represent one of three independent experiments.

edges.mechanism: Thy28-V5 cells have fewer low-potential cells over12-48 h; the representative48 h values are75.6% vector versus59.9% Thy28. This is a partial cellular protection phenotype, not direct control of a mitochondrial channel.
edges.subject: thy28-v5-expression

evidence.explanation: Original Figure2B quadrant labels provide clone- and time-specific values, rather than a generic anti-apoptotic effect in every comparison.
evidence.snippet: Data represent one of three independent experiments.

edges.mechanism: At24 h the lower-right annexinV/7-AAD quadrant is33.3% in vector versus15.8% and3.8% in clones3/6. At48 h clone3 approaches control,54.2% versus56.6%; clone6 remains38.1%. Clone6 secondary-necrotic24 h cells are15.3% versus12.8% vector, so an all-quadrant protection claim is unsupported.
edges.subject: thy28-v5-expression

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Mouse Thy28 reference Q91YJ3 equals BAC21100.1/NP_653126.1,226 aa,PF01878 at56-219. Human THYN1 Q9P016 also maps56-218. The Thy28-V5 insert sequence/species is unresolved; mouse host identity does not verify the insert. No isolated EVE domain is tested.
causal_graphs.limitations: Stable overexpression is not physiological necessity. Figure1 confirms Thy28-V5 expression and similar IgM/MHCI surface signals. Clone selection, tag effects and indirect signaling remain possible. Protection is partial, time- and clone-dependent; no uniform reduction of every death quadrant is claimed.

record.description: This domain was formerly known as DUF55. Crystal structures have shown that this domain is part of the PUA superfamily. This domain has been named EVE and is thought to be RNA-binding [[cite:PUB00055624]].

evidence.explanation: Figures3/5/7 and S2 were inspected;7-week splenic Pax5 MFI280/285/280 and Pax5-positive95.6/94.7/95.6% for WT/het/KO. B-cell counts across8.1-38.7-week mice show no significant difference, not statistical equivalence. Raji uses CRISPR despite main-text knockdown wording.
DT40 depletion/rescue supports a local contribution; it does not establish a universal vertebrate requirement or direct promoter binding.

discussions.notes: Separate species from lineage state, transformed-cell context, acute versus stable perturbation and compensatory adaptation. Inspect the unreviewed2019 S1 image before relying on its LN/spleen-discrepant caption. No negative edge was invented for unchanged readouts. Test matched systems and quantitative power before universal claims.
discussions.prompt: Explain why DT40 Pax5 dependence is not reproduced in tested mammalian contexts.
discussions.rationale: Kitaura2019 mouse exons3-7 knockout retains splenic Pax5 and B-cell counts; human Nalm-6 knockdown and Raji CRISPR mutants retain Pax5. These context-specific negatives restrict transfer of the chicken result without disproving challenged WEHI-231 phenotypes.

evidence.explanation: Stable overexpression changes multiple readouts with baseline differences; the construct citation is incongruous and Figure3A timing is unspecified. No p27/JNK/ROS mediation experiment is supplied.
Rescue and ChIP support system-level effects, while direct DNA/RNA contacts, domain necessity and Fig9 molecular routes remain untested.

discussions.notes: Verify tagged insert sequences, expression/folding/localization controls and domain-specific perturbations. Measure direct binding or biochemical action; use mediation experiments rather than joining parallel cellular readouts. H2DCFDA is not specific H2O2 concentration and phospho/cleavage blots are not catalytic-rate assays. Preserve reused rescue lanes and nonexpressing controls.
discussions.prompt: Resolve construct sequences and the molecular contribution of EVE.
discussions.rationale: WEHI-231 insert sequence/species is unresolved; DT40 cDNA is not batch-sequenced here and chicken references differ at51 outside EVE. All retained effects are indirect whole-cell observations, not residue-level mechanisms.

evidence.explanation: Pastor2021 describes WP_010645282 and structural EVE homology. Exact sequence-family assignment and original causal figures still need review before importing its modification-dependent restriction mechanism.
Spruijt2013 modified-base proteomics is a follow-up lead; the member-specific data and assay conditions were not inspected and support no retained edge yet.

discussions.notes: Inspect Spruijt full text and supplemental member tables,5J3E construct/ligand evidence,SmMcrB primary figures/mapping,Lutz2019 architecture-screen results and Bell2020 computational family boundaries. Resolve exact WP_010645282 sequence and Pfam support; absent annotation in a different homolog is not proof that the paper's enzyme is outside PF01878. No whole-family biochemical characterization is claimed.
discussions.prompt: Extend EVE coverage with exact member mapping before transferring restriction or modified-base mechanisms.
discussions.rationale: All11128 frozen proteins remain in scope. VcaM4I's structural EVE assignment does not supply a verified PF01878 match; RCSB-linked A0ABY5IHE6 differs at13 positions from6YEXentity1 and its current Pfam response reports only HNH_2.
